summary: @servicetitan/admin-layout preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime release from github.com/oven-sh/bun and then invokes that Bun binary via execFileSync to execute a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` and uses string-array rotation obfuscation (rotator function and large numeric/string constant array) — the canonical obfuscator.io shape. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated bundled script on `npm install` is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that evades Node-based static and dynamic analysis, since the payload executes under Bun rather than Node. The package presents itself as a React admin-layout UI library with an empty description, which does not require a second language runtime or an opaque executable blob. The `@servicetitan/*` scope suggests impersonation/dependency-confusion targeting ServiceTitan's internal packages.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
